what: Rollins provides pest control. Through Orkin and a group of other brands it treats homes and businesses for insects, rodents and termites, mostly under recurring service contracts.
customers: Homeowners, restaurants, food processors, hotels and commercial property managers across North America and internationally.
moat: Route density: once a technician's daily route is full in a neighbourhood, each additional customer costs almost nothing to serve, which smaller competitors cannot match.
risks: Growth depends partly on continuous small acquisitions
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
Mild winters reduce pest activity and demand
Technician recruitment and retention is a persistent constraint
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 23% with very low debt
Revenue grew about 11% last year and about 12% a year over three years
Pest control contracts renew automatically and are rarely cancelled in a recession
watch: Organic revenue growth and customer retention rates.
